extracted.name: Swedish Chocolate Balls (or Coconut Balls)
extracted.description: This recipe for Swedish chocolate balls (or coconut balls) is for no-bake morsels with oats, sugar, cocoa, butter, coffee, chocolate, and coconut.
ingredient_lines: 2 (1 ounce) squares unsweetened baking chocolate, melted
instruction_lines: Combine oats, sugar, and cocoa in a bowl. Add butter; mix, using your hands, until makes a thick dough. Mix in chocolate, coffee, and vanilla until thoroughly blended.

Place coconut flakes in a small bowl. Pinch off small pieces of dough; roll into balls (about 1 ½ inches). Roll balls in coconut flakes. Balls are ready to eat, or refrigerate to become firmer, about 2 hours.
